_readme: Hand corrections layered on top of the scraped data. checklist_fixes are keyed by English name as written on the Wikipedia list; species overrides are keyed by species id (slug of the scientific name). Any field here wins over scraped data AND over the other curated/*.json files (applied last). 'season' is one of: resident, winter, summer, passage, vagrant. 'facts' is a list of short, sourced, true sentences.

Smew._why: Wikipedia list typo: shows Bucephala clangula (common goldeneye)

Blue-capped rock-thrush._why: Wikipedia list typo: shows Monticola rufiventris (chestnut-bellied)

Demoiselle crane._why: Wikipedia list typo: shows Anthropoides antigone

Gray bushchat._why: Wikipedia list typo: shows Oenanthe deserti (desert wheatear)

facts: The national bird of Bangladesh, known as the doyel (দোয়েল).

aythya-baeri._why: regular winter visitor in small numbers, not accidental; chandrabindu fix

calidris-pygmaea._why: regular winter visitor (tiny numbers), not accidental

psittacula-krameri._why: native to the Indian subcontinent, not introduced

butorides-striata._why: Old World birds are the little heron (B. atricapilla); earlier facts came from the South American striated heron article
